title: Parity conjecture for elliptic curves
exact_target: Does the product of an elliptic curve's local root-number signs always determine whether its rational-point rank over the number field is even or odd?

sources.citation: Kęstutis Česnavičius, The p-parity conjecture for elliptic curves with a p-isogeny; arXiv1207.0431v3 April8,2014; PDF internal date May22,2018.
